core_struggle: Feels like their own worst enemy and always sabotaging themselves, and wants to understand self-improvement.
mirror: You are your own worst enemy, and you want to know what the Gita says about improving yourself.

queries.hook: The feeling of being your own worst enemy, always sabotaging yourself, and the unease of it.
queries.diagnose: When the mind turns against itself, it becomes its own enemy; self-blame grows from believing the sabotage is who you are.
queries.steady: The self is its own friend or its own enemy; lift yourself up, do not push yourself down.
queries.act: Lift yourself up instead of pushing yourself down; learn what this taught you, make amends where you can, and begin again.
queries.story: A man who turned his mind against itself, faced the ruin it brought, and found the courage to lift himself up.

bridge: The Gita says the self is its own friend or its own enemy. It is the mind turned against itself that you are feeling.
week_thesis: Seven days from feeling like your own worst enemy to seeing the mind turned against itself and learning to lift yourself up.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the self-sabotage and the self-blame, named without judgement.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that it is the mind turned against itself, not who you are.
week_beats.steady: You hold that the self is its own friend or its own enemy, and you can choose which one you will be.
week_beats.story: A man who turned his mind against itself shows you what lifting yourself up looks like from the inside.

insight: You are your own worst enemy. The Gita says the self is its own friend or its own enemy, and the mind turned against itself is what you are feeling.
seat: a person who feels they are their own worst enemy
life_context: A person who feels they are their own worst enemy and wants to understand self-improvement from the Gita.
details: feels like their own worst enemy
asks what the Gita says about self-improvement
